description: I've been a professional software developer since 2019, but my journey in technology began in 2017, when I started my Bachelor's degree in Information Systems. During my studies, I participated in extension, research and teaching projects — experiences that helped me build a strong base in software development.

Since then, I've worked in different contexts and technologies, starting with systems designed for small cities and regional organizations, then evolved to develop modern applications with cloud infrastructure. These experiences gave me exposure to software architecture, system design, and teamwork, always focused in solution planning and delivering business value

Nowadays, I enjoy turning complex and manual processes into simple solutions. I'm always learning and searching not only to understand how to build software, but building then efficiently and with strong performance.

description.location: São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Brazil
description.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Designed and implemented an workflow for signing documents, which includes PDF creation, automated signature requests, webhook based status check, signed document storage and notification, eliminating manual document handling across 100+ documents monthly.

Managed AWS Infrastructure in production and test environments, by configuring DNS, SSL/TLS certificates, load balancing, caching and application resilience while setting CI/CD pipelines in AWS CodePipeline to automate the lifecycle, from build to deployment.

Cooperated with the Product Owner to the evaluation of feasibility, scope and tradeoffs in new initiatives, independently researching for new solutions and integration possibilities with legacy and existing systems, providing technical expertise to influence the costs, timelines and sprint planning decisions.
Built REST APIs with Nest.js and PostgreSQL for implementation of core business workflows and integrations, while maintaining reliable data handling.

Developed responsive interfaces using React and a shared design system between internal systems, improving UI consistency and development efficiency while using caching, containerization, and automated testing to support application performance and reliability.

description.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Redesigned the search and data retrieval strategy in an auction platform, decreasing the response time of complex queries from approximately ~70s to ~1s (98% improvement).
Improved a hotel management system in availability and performance while integrating application modules with payment system.
Migrated applications from other cloud services to Google Cloud Platform, with zero downtime, configuring VMs, Nginx, SSL, and CI/CD pipelines to modernize infrastructure and automate deployments.
Enhanced web and mobile applications for multiple clients, implementing features and fixing bugs.
